summary_1line: Narrators discuss Narada’s vision of Narayana and his visit to the ascetics Nara and Narayana, praising Narayana’s supremacy and recounting Narada’s encounter with them at Badari.

image_candidates.scene_text: Narada descends from the sky into the Himalayan hermitage of Badari where the radiant sages Nara and Narayana sit in deep austerity.
The twin sages Nara and Narayana, marked with the Srivatsa on their chests and four arms each, glow with sunlike brilliance as Narada bows before them.
Narada stands in awe before the two ascetics whose bodies bear divine marks like the discus on their feet and swan-foot signs on their palms.
